message: Generated from Stimulation_2emg.hex Debug build on 2026-07-04 with corrected PPG 25 Hz timing: SAADC hardware oversampling disabled so one 10 ms timer trigger produces one SAADC callback, 40 ms PPG frame, about 10 ms LED-on pulse, single Green/IR/Red PPG output 25 Hz, alternating Green/IR/Red output 8.3 Hz per channel, RATE? query including PPG_LED_ON_MS and SAADC_OVERSAMPLE, RATE<hz>/SR<hz>/HZ<hz> raw ADC commands, 1-500 Hz accepted with integer-ms interval readback, app UART on P0.25/P0.26, Green/IR/Red LED pins P0.11/P0.12/P0.13, DAC A/B bias amp commands, active single ADC streaming with selectable ADC3/ADC2/ADC0 input, PPG ambient-subtracted phase sampling, single-source 9999 bitmap support, residual/delta TRNG mixing, Von Neumann extraction, and UART DFU bootloader entry.
